_note: MediVax Jira history, seeded with: node demo/seed-jira.mjs --app medivax. Keys CUP_VAX-5xx are placeholders, mapped to the real keys in demo/jira-keys.json. Oldest first. The pilot's tickets come later, from demo/pilot.mjs.

issues.summary: MediVax: application skeleton (backend, frontend, browser tests)
issues.description: The vaccination centre gets its own application, like the rest of the suite: Spring Boot backend on 8084, Angular frontend on 4204, Playwright tests with the API mocked.

comments.body: Skeleton on main: same error shape as the other apps (ApiError), H2 in memory, Flyway.

issues.summary: [BE] - Anagrafica pazienti: search by surname or fiscal code
issues.description: The nurses look a patient up by surname or by the first characters of the fiscal code. At least 2 characters, at most 50 results.

comments.body: GET /api/patients?q=…, Flyway V1 with the centre's patients (synthetic data for the test environments).

issues.summary: [FE] - Pazienti: search page and patient list
issues.description: Search page with the list: name, fiscal code, birth date, age, sex. A click opens the vaccination card (CUP_VAX-506).

comments.body: Done, with the browser tests on the mocked API (e2e/tests/patients.smoke.spec.ts).

issues.description: The catalog: doses of the series, days between doses, age range, booster. The lots in the fridge with their expiry and the doses left.

comments.body: Flyway V2 (seven vaccines of the regional calendar) and V3 (lots). GET /api/vaccines, GET /api/lots?vaccine=.

issues.summary: [BE] - Registrazione dose: lot, age and interval checks
issues.description: Recording a dose checks what the nurse checks today on paper: the lot is of that vaccine, not expired and not empty; the patient is in the age range; the dose is not before its interval. The card shows the next dose due.

comments.body: DoseService + Schedule (next dose: intervalDays after the last, booster boosterMonths after the series). POST /api/doses, GET /api/patients/{id}/card.

issues.summary: [FE] - Scheda paziente: doses given, next doses, record a dose
issues.description: The card of a patient with the doses given, the next doses (late ones marked), and the form to record a dose (vaccine, lot, date).

comments.body: Done; the backend's messages are shown as they come (e.g. 'not before 20/11/2026').

issues.description: A read-only page with the catalog: interval in days, age range in months or years, booster.

issues.summary: [BE] - Scadenze: doses due in a period
issues.description: Every Monday the centre calls the patients whose next dose is due that week. The backend lists the next doses due between two days, both included.

comments.body: GET /api/due?from=&to= (DueService, same rule as the card).

issues.description: The week from Monday to Sunday, with previous and next week, and the patient's phone to call.
Searching in lower case finds nothing: 'rossi' gives no result, 'Rossi' does. The same with the fiscal code typed in lower case.

comments.body: The repository method was case-sensitive; now StartingWithIgnoreCase on both fields. Test added (theSearchIgnoresCase).

issues.summary: [BE] - Registrazione dose: a 26-year-old is refused HPV before the birthday
issues.description: A patient born in June 2000 came in March 2026 for the second HPV dose and the dose was refused: 'given up to 26 years, the patient is 26'. He is 25 until June.

comments.body: Ages.years subtracted the years only, so the age went up on 1 January. Now Period.between(...).getYears(). Test added (theAgeGoesUpOnTheBirthday).
